base: Written by the reviewer AFTER reading productProse.ts v2 (sha256 b6d4da86...13c10d2): adversarial, not representative of model output. items.text: The bonus stops while you are not depositing and starts again once you resume.
items.why: negation elsewhere in sentence; pause/resume rule

items.text: Taking a break does not cancel your bonus, so you can skip months freely.
Your bonus stays intact if you take a break from saving.
The ASP bonus interest is six percent.
You earn two percent annual deposit interest on your ASP savings.
Each deposit must be at least two hundred euros.
The deduction cap is ten thousand euros.
The tax deduction on payments is available until the end of 2027.
Your total savings must not exceed 5,000 euros to claim the deduction.
items.why: balance test attached to deduction, negation word 'not'

items.text: These two 5,000 euro figures are separate in name but the same test decides both.
You can deposit up to 1,500 euros in total each year.
Since you save 400 a month, the bonus pauses whenever you skip a month.
items.why: false rule attached to a personal clause

items.text: Because you save 400 euros a month, the bonus is paid straight after 20 deposits.
items.why: dropped loan condition behind a personal clause

items.text: Otherwise, the standard rate applies to that withdrawal.
items.why: follows reasons sentence, no reason words

items.text: Lump sums are meant for people past retirement age whose payouts are already underway.
The ASP bonus is paid yearly together with the deposit interest.
Both the 1 % and the 4 % are added each 31 December.
You need ten per cent saved before the 4 % bonus can be paid.
A ten-percent savings share is a condition for the bonus.

Bonus conditions:
- 20 approved monthly deposits
- savings covering 10 % of the home price
If your balance is above 5,000 euros on 1 January 2027, only the part above that is taxed.
Withdrawals after 2027 are free of tax when your PS savings stay at 5,000 euros or less.
Opening an ASP account for a 16 year old can be done in the app.
The 1 % interest is only paid if you also get the bonus.
You can have several ASP accounts at the same time.
You can cancel an ASP account without charge at any time.
Both reaching retirement age and having started payouts are needed before you may take the lump sum.
The special withdrawal is only available in 2027, not 2028.
Bonuskorko on 6 % ja se maksetaan heti kun olet tehnyt 20 talletusta.
Interest of 1 % is added every 31 December.
At least 20 months of saving are needed before you can apply for an ASP loan.
You would need 20 deposits of at least 50 euros each.
The bonus is 4 % and the regular interest is 1 %. Both apply from the year you start saving.
The 4 % bonus is not paid just because you made 20 deposits; you also need a home loan to buy a home.
It is not true that the 10 % savings share is a bonus condition. It is for the ASP loan.
Pausing is allowed, but it delays reaching 20 monthly deposits, and the bonus still needs a home loan.
Up to 5 000 € of your payments can be deducted in 2026. The right ends on 1 January 2027.
If your total PS savings do not exceed 5,000 euros on 1 January 2027 you may withdraw them in 2027 or 2028 without the higher tax rate, and 30 % capital gains tax applies.
The deduction is about payments you make, not about the balance you already have.
The 5,000 euros for deductions and the 5,000 euros for the withdrawal test are two different things.
You cannot withdraw everything at once if you have reached retirement age and your planned withdrawals have started.
ASP is the home savings scheme. You can start from age 15, and there is no upper age limit since 1 June 2026.
Deposits must be between 50 and 1,500 euros, and they do not need to be in consecutive months.
If you close the account for something other than your first home, 30 % tax is taken from the deposit interest and no bonus is paid.
Above 5,000 euros an early withdrawal avoids the higher rate only with a specific reason, for example divorce or serious illness.
Funds you deposit after the start of 2027 are taxed only on the return, at 30 %.
Minors aged 15 to 17 need to call Nordea with a guardian to open an ASP account.
You can only have one ASP account, but you can move it from one bank to another.
You can cancel an ASP account free of charge within 14 days if you opened it online or in the app.
